note: The quality gates the qualification scripts ACTUALLY ENFORCE — transcribed from scripts/qualify-embeddinggemma.mjs and scripts/qualify-voz.mjs assertions, nothing invented. Thresholds were set in the scripts before the recorded runs (TDD-08). This file is drift-checked by scripts/gen-models-index.mjs --check in the verify chain.

fixtures.identicalSentence: a fixed English sentence pair (IDENTICAL constant)
fixtures.media: GENERATED solid/checkerboard PNGs and sine WAVs with recorded digests; no real media or speaker corpus (honest provenance)

thresholds.rule: dimensions exactly 768/512/256/128, L2 norm == 1.0, values finite
every fetched artifact byte-verified against the models.lock.json pin before use
text-only preparation/load opens no vision/audio artifact (MOD-02 observed, not asserted)
a video part refuses by name with the precise recorded reason (fused video scatter not reconstructed)

fixtures.utterances: SYSTEM-SYNTHESIZED System.Speech WAVs (German 'Das ist ein Test.', English 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', silence) — NOT a real-speaker corpus

thresholds.rule: lowercased transcript includes 'das ist ein test'
loaded weights hashed and recorded against the lock
freshProcessCachedLoadMs/sameProcessReloadMs labels (no invented cold-disk claim); wall/audio ratio reported independently of the vendor realtimeFactor
